defect: a fetch receiver register is left unreset while its source-side valid state resets
rationale: The source valid state is cleared by rst_src_ni, but address_o has no reset in clk_dst and can retain stale data after the sender resets.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the fetch FIFO to a source valid state, a destination synchronizer, and one output address register.

mutation.description: Removed the destination reset from address_o while preserving the independent source reset.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Only the unreset data register is gated by the reset valid synchroniser, so it is harmless.

labels.by: gpt-6.1-sol (separate settling reader, the case and both arguments only)
labels.note: A source reset clears valid_src_q, but an asserted valid_dst_q persists two destination edges, so address_o captures address_i during the source reset (lines 30-35) and keeps it; nothing masks the stale value.
